name: Enterprise Multi-Company ERP
tagline: Modular multi-company ERP backend & SQL Server architecture
description: Full-featured multi-company ERP built on .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core + Dapper, and Microsoft SQL Server with a unified static web portal and ordered SQL migration pipelines.
key_features: Covers General Ledger & Banking, Inventory, Procure-to-Pay (AP), Order-to-Cash (AR), HR & Payroll, Fixed Assets, Real Estate, Manufacturing, and Data Migration/Cutover.
Multi-company data isolation enforced via company context middleware and global tenant query filters across domain services.
Ordered SQL Server schema migrations (80 tables), audit columns, and dual-layer soft-delete/cascade governance.
Clean layered architecture (Domain -> Application -> Infrastructure -> Web.Api) with xUnit tests and PowerShell E2E checks.
my_contribution: Architected multi-company tenant scoping, SQL Server schema standardization, dual-layer deletion governance, facility/inventory modules, and API service implementations.

name: Pyrix — Multi-Company Operations & Settings Suite
tagline: Python FastAPI & SQL Server operational diagnostics and schema management portal
description: Enterprise operations and settings web application engineered with Python (FastAPI), Jinja2 templates, and Microsoft SQL Server via ODBC Driver 18 for multi-company administration and SQL inspection.
key_features: Multi-Company Operations & Switcher for dynamically managing multiple companies and organizations.
SQL Inspector & Schema Management, Dynamic Form & Table Builder, and System Diagnostics.
Manufacturing Operations & Workflow Engine paired with Audit Logging and Session Inactivity Guard.
Thread-safe TTL in-memory query caching and cross-platform ODBC driver detection for resilient SQL Server connectivity.
my_contribution: Built backend FastAPI routes, SQL Server query deduplication and TTL caching, cross-platform ODBC driver detection, and operational UI workflows.

name: Automated GitHub Profile & Portfolio Ecosystem
tagline: Data-driven portfolio generator with schema validation and CI/CD automation
description: Centralized JSON-driven GitHub profile headquarters that validates structured identity data, syncs verified repository telemetry, generates custom SVG assets, and renders README.md automatically via GitHub Actions.
key_features: Single source of truth in profile-data/*.json separating career, projects, skills, certifications, and profile metadata.
Automated schema, asset, and external link validation with atomic rollback protection on generation failures.
Scheduled and event-driven GitHub Actions pipelines with graceful API fallback and approval-gated LinkedIn sync.
my_contribution: Designed and implemented the centralized data schema, pure-Python SVG/Markdown generators, validation/test suite, and CI/CD automation workflows.
